d:
What if your brother could hear every single thought you had… with absolutely no filter?
This Rakhi, Maahi’s unfiltered thoughts are finally out in the open, and Ansh is hearing ALL of them. From secretly stealing his chocolate and sneaking out of the house, watch what happens when your brother suddenly knows exactly what you’re thinking.
Because when siblings can already read each other like a book, giving them access to your thoughts is just asking for trouble.
